nodes.label: AMPM Role and Permission Matrix (DRAFT v0.2)
Governing rule: backend APIs and file storage enforce access (SPEC §6.1)
nodes.rationale: Hiding frontend controls is not sufficient; every matrix cell is a server-side check applied to API requests, file links, exports and notifications alike.

nodes.label: P-1 Nine global staff roles, five assigned-scoped and four module-wide
nodes.rationale: PM, Creative, VC, RSVP and Hospitality act only on weddings they are members of; SA, Sales, Hotel team and Finance act across their module. AMPM: departments confirmed, final roles and cost access to confirm.

nodes.label: P-2 Client roles replaced by two equal family representatives
nodes.rationale: Owner, Approver and Viewer collapsed into one CR role after AMPM chose two representatives, one per side, with equal rights; separate accounts recommended so approvals carry a name.

nodes.label: P-3 Four finance visibility tiers
nodes.rationale: Client-facing amounts; internal cost and margin; vendor and hotel contracts, quotes and received invoices; bank details. Internal commercial data never reaches clients.

nodes.label: P-4 Guest token bound to one family group
nodes.rationale: Changed by Q7: links per side or combined, guests identify themselves, no editing after submission, no access to other households.

nodes.label: P-5 Identity documents restricted to RSVP with explicit grant and Hospitality at check-in
nodes.rationale: Super Admin has audited break-glass read; clients, Finance, Sales, Creative and VC never see them; exports never include them.

nodes.label: P-6 Sign-in methods per principal
nodes.rationale: Changed: mobile OTP for prospects and clients; staff method to be finalised; guests hold a token only.

nodes.label: P-7 Demo prospect sees a limited hotel set with indicative prices
nodes.rationale: Demo enquiries route to Sales as lead activities rather than to the Hotel team.

nodes.label: P-8 Readiness exceptions authorised by Eva's authorised personnel (SA) only
nodes.rationale: Changed by Q10: the Project Manager may request, not authorise; the authority stays configurable.

nodes.label: P-9 On-behalf client decisions with evidence
nodes.rationale: PM or SA may record approvals and vendor selections for the client only with a note or supporting record; the audit log shows who recorded it.

nodes.label: P-10 Exports never include sensitive or identity fields
nodes.rationale: Internal cost and margin exports limited to Finance and SA; every export audited with filter and row count.

nodes.label: P-11 Vendors and hotels have no principal type
Permission-matrix changes from AMPM decisions of 25 October 2026
Seven-layer authorisation model
nodes.rationale: Principal type, global role, project scope, entitlement, record visibility, field visibility class, action; a request must pass every applicable layer in order.

nodes.label: Separate response models per principal and permission
nodes.rationale: One endpoint, several serialisers; never one model with fields blanked out in the client.

nodes.label: Denial is silent about existence
nodes.rationale: A client asking for a record they cannot see gets the same response as for a record that does not exist (SPEC §12 tampering test).

nodes.label: Files follow records via short-lived signed URLs
nodes.rationale: Download links are minted only after the record check passes (document_access_links).

nodes.label: Client entitlement resolution by account state (§3)
nodes.rationale: Module set derived from subscriptions, service agreements and project_members combined; computed per request and cached for at most five minutes.

nodes.label: Entitlement changes never delete or hide records from staff
nodes.rationale: A downgrade is read-only first, removal later; the client is told what changed and when (WHY §4, SPEC §7).

nodes.label: Payment activates only the purchased entitlement
nodes.rationale: A subscription payment never grants wedding workspace access and a service agreement never grants hotel search (SPEC §8).

nodes.label: Field visibility classes (§4)
nodes.rationale: Every column belongs to exactly one class; the class decides which serialiser includes it and which permission key unlocks it.

nodes.label: Client, guest and demo permission matrix (§6)
Guest link rules
nodes.rationale: A link identifies a side or the whole wedding; the guest identifies their household; the portal never shows counts, other households, budgets or staff names; submissions lock; every submission writes an rsvp_responses snapshot.

nodes.label: Demo prospect rules
nodes.rationale: Demo authorised by AMPM after an enquiry, opened with mobile OTP, limited to configured hotels with indicative prices, expires and is reset to seed on a schedule; demo-created data is visible only to Sales.

nodes.label: Status transitions and who may make them (§7)
Automation performed by the system principal (§8)
nodes.rationale: Every system change is still written to audit_events with actor_type = system.

nodes.label: Permission keys: module.resource.action with :assigned or :own scope (§10)
nodes.rationale: Client and guest principals do not use permission keys; their access is computed from membership, entitlement and fixed rules.

nodes.label: Super Admin break-glass identity-document read (audited and alerted)
required_decisions multi-approver rule
nodes.rationale: Approved needs required_decisions approvals, one by default; one rejection or revision request moves the approval immediately.

nodes.label: Retention jobs propose deletions; Super Admin approves
nodes.rationale: AMPM decided (Q8, Q17) there is no automatic deletion; nothing is deleted until SA approves.
